{{Quote|When Ship came to us with the news of the near extinction of the Sith, we did not fall victim to despair. We acted. Vessel by vessel, we are assembling a fleet with which we will eventually take back the galaxy from the Jedi, who spread like vermin throughout system after system.|Lady Rhea|<ref name="Omen" />}}
The '''Sith armada''' was a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of [[Starship/Legends|starships]] captured for use by the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]]&mdash;descendants of a group of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] who survived the crash-landing of their [[Warship/Legends|warship]], the ''[[Omen]]'', on the remote [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]] in [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]]&mdash;with the purpose of conquering the weakened [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] and reviving the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]]. In [[41 ABY]], a [[Sith Meditation Sphere]] known as [[Ship (Sith Meditation Sphere)|Ship]] arrived on the planet. The Tribe began using Ship to attack vessels, at first to [[Scavenger/Legends|scavenge]] parts to repair the ''Omen'' and later to capture them and expand their fleet. By [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], their armada contained more than two dozen ships. [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lady]] [[Olaris Rhea|Rhea]] and her [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]], [[Vestara Khai]], served in the armada aboard the ''[[Eternal Crusader]]'', a starship used by the [[Lost Tribe of Sith strike team|Sith strike team]] sent to recover Ship and eliminate [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] in 43 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]]. The strike team was [[Skirmish at Sinkhole Station|decimated]] by the Jedi, however, with Khai the only survivor.

Lord [[Viun Gaalan]] then led a group of [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]] to [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] to retrieve Khai and a group of [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] that she helped to [[Skirmish in the Dathomir landing meadow|capture]]. However, after Jedi [[Duel in the Dathomir landing meadow|intervention]], Khai was captured. As the Jedi flew into [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]], however, they were taken by surprise by a group of eleven [[ChaseMaster]] [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]] led by [[High Lord (Circle of Lords)|High Lord]] [[Sarasu Taalon]], who proposed they form an alliance in order to destroy [[Abeloth]], a powerful [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] being. However, the Sith actually intended to force Abeloth to serve them. During the [[Mission to the Maw|ensuing mission]], [[Starstalker|one ship]] took part in an [[Violation|illegal raid]] and was apprehended with its crew condemned to [[Death/Legends|death]], and another was obliterated after colliding with debris of the remnants of the destroyed [[Sinkhole Station]]. The mission eventually ended in failure for the Sith, as Skywalker defeated Abeloth, and the entire flotilla was sent back to Kesh while the Skywalkers, Taalon, Khai, and [[Gavar Khai|Khai's father]] remained on [[Abeloth's planet]] to investigate more about Abeloth.

Meanwhile, the Sith armada continued to grow with its continuous [[Pirate/Legends|piracy]] of vessels, and the Sith prepared their fleet for war. Part of the fleet engaged a wing of Jedi [[StealthX]] [[Starfighter/Legends|fighters]] in [[Battle in the Fallanassi village|battle]] over the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Pydyr]], but the Sith were forced to retreat. Soon afterward, a Sith flotilla [[Operation Shieldfall|engaged]] the Jedi over the planet [[Nam Chorios/Legends|Nam Chorios]], but they were again defeated. [[Abeloth's fleet|Part]] of the armada later [[Destruction of Tahv|defected]] to join Abeloth. The Sith Tribe then traveled to infiltrate the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] after the [[New Jedi Order]] vacated the world. A small force also attempted to ambush the [[Jedi Academy (Ossus)|Jedi academy]] on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]], but the majority of the Jedi forces, assisted by the [[Hapes Consortium/Legends|Hapes Consortium]], escaped. Soon afterward, the Sith received a crippling blow with the [[Liberation of Coruscant (Lost Tribe of Sith emergence)|destruction]] of their forces on Coruscant.

==Description==
{{Quote|We will need more than you, Ship, if we are to conquer worlds in the name of the Sith.|Vestara Khai|<ref name="Omen" />}}
The [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] armada was a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] in use by the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]]&mdash;a group of Sith stranded on the remote [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. The [[Starship/Legends|ships]] in the fleet were varied, ranging from large [[Bulk freighter/Legends|bulk freighters]] to [[Warship/Legends|warships]] to a [[Sith Meditation Sphere]]. The Sith worked together as a team to acquire vessels, often employing several starships together during an attack. After a vessel was captured by the Tribe, it was towed back to their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of Kesh to be repaired, renamed, and integrated into the armada.<ref name="Omen" />

[[File:Lost_Sith_Tribe_world.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Kesh, homeworld of the Lost Tribe of Sith]]
The first vessel in the armada was [[Ship (Sith Meditation Sphere)|Ship]], the Sith Meditation Sphere. At first, it served as the leader of the armada; it knew where to take the Tribe to find a new target and was the Tribe's only means of transportation off-planet. Once the Tribe had acquired enough parts, they managed to repair the ''[[Omen]]'',<ref name="Omen" /> the [[Sith dreadnaught|dreadnaught]]<ref name="Crosscurrent">''[[Crosscurrent]]''</ref> in which the Tribe's ancestors had crashed onto Kesh more than [[5000 BBY/Legends|five thousand years prior]]. With the ''Omen'' repaired, the Tribe began capturing vessels, rather than just foraging them for parts, and the fleet quickly grew. By [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], it numbered more than two dozen vessels.<ref name="Omen" />

One of the first vessels to be commandeered was the ''[[Eternal Crusader]]'', a warship larger and more powerful than the ''Omen''. It served under the command of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lady]] [[Olaris Rhea]] and was used in the capture of several more vessels.<ref name="Omen" /> Other [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] in the armada included several [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] [[ChaseMaster|frigates]], two [[EE-104 Fisheye]] stealth vessels,<ref name="Conviction" /> and no fewer than twenty-seven [[ChaseMaster]] [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]],<ref name="Vortex" /> among them the ''[[Black Wave]]'',<ref name="lash" /> which served under the command of [[High Lord (Circle of Lords)|High Lord]] [[Sarasu Taalon]], the ''[[Starstalker]]'', which was commanded by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Vyn Holpur]], and the ''[[Winged Dagger]]'', which was commanded first by Captain [[Syndor]], then [[Leeha Faal]], and then Syndor again, following Faal's [[Death/Legends|death]].<ref name="Allies" /> The armada employed several [[Corporate Sector gunship]]s,<ref name="Conviction" /> and among the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] used were at least six [[Javelin (starfighter)|''Javelins'']]<ref name="Vortex" /> and a full wing of [[GAT-12 Skipray Blastboat|Skipray twelve-jays]].<ref name="Apocalypse">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse]]''</ref> By [[44 ABY]], the Sith had spread throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], refining their [[Pirate/Legends|piracy]] techniques and preparing a war fleet consisting of hundreds of vessels.<ref name="Vortex" />

==History==
{{Quote|I will teach you. I will teach all of you.|Ship, to Vestara Khai|<ref name="Omen" />}}
In 5,000 BBY, during the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]], a Sith starship, the ''Omen'', crash-landed on the remote planet of Kesh while [[Skirmish over Phaegon III|attempting]] to transport [[Lignan crystal]]s to [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]]. The survivors of the crash eventually formed a group called the Lost Tribe of Sith.<ref name="Precipice">''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Precipice]]''</ref>

Ship, a Sith Meditation Sphere, arrived on Kesh in [[41 ABY]] and made contact with the Tribe, revealing that the Sith had been driven from the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], and only a [[One Sith|small group]] remained. The Tribe decided that it was their destiny to restore the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]], and Ship then told them that it could help them repair the ''Omen'' by scavenging parts from other vessels. Ship took the Sith aboard, and for the first time in around 5,000 [[Standard year/Legends|years]], members of the Tribe left the planet's [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] and returned to [[Realspace/Legends|space]].<ref name="Omen" /> Ship called for five Sith to join it in an attack on a [[Damorian Manufacturing Corporation/Legends|Damorian]] [[s18 light freighter]] en route from the planet [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]]. High Lord Sarasu Taalon, Lady Olaris Rhea, Rhea's [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] [[Vestara Khai]], Lord [[Ivaar Workan]], and [[Sith Saber]] [[Ruku Myal]] were chosen for the [[Skirmish near Eriadu|mission]]. Ship opened fire on the freighter and forced it to crash<ref name="First Blood">{{InsiderCite|125|First Blood (short story)}}</ref> on an uninhabited planet. The crew of the ship was then [[Death/Legends|slaughtered]] by the Sith, and the defeated vessel's parts were scavenged to help begin the repairs on the ''Omen''.<ref name="Omen" />

With the help of Ship, the Sith constructed a simple [[Tahv spaceport|spaceport]] for their new armada.<ref name="Ascension" /> Meanwhile, the Tribe began to attack more vessels, leaving no being left alive to reveal the location of their homeworld. Eventually, the ''Omen'' was completely repaired, and it became the first vessel to serve alongside Ship in the armada. The Tribe continued their attacks, now capturing vessels and pressing them into service in the fleet. The new lifestyle forced the spacefaring Tribe members to change their [[Sith apparel|clothing]] and weaponry to be more efficient for their new duties. By [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], the armada numbered more than two dozen starships.<ref name="Omen" />

===Strike team===
{{Quote|Luke Skywalker has done much to fight the Sith, the dark side. He was at one point the last Jedi, and now he has re-created the Order with hundreds of them. And now, somehow, he has broadcast his presence into the Force. And we can take him down.|Lady Rhea|<ref name="Omen" />}}
[[File:Vestara.jpg|thumb|right|175px|Vestara Khai, sole survivor of the strike team sent to kill Luke Skywalker]]
In 43.5 ABY, [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] touched an [[Aing-Tii/Legends|Aing-Tii]] [[Relics|relic]], the [[Codex]], which amplified his presence and called out his name to the Tribe through [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Ship revealed to the Tribe the danger that Skywalker presented to them, and the Tribe's [[Grand Lord]], [[Darish Vol]], called an emergency meeting in the [[Circle Chambers]] in Kesh's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Tahv]]. Vol and Rhea chose a [[Lost Tribe of Sith strike team|strike team]] from the armada, commanded by Rhea, to be sent to hunt down Skywalker, but before they could depart, Ship abruptly left the planet to follow the call through the Force. The strike team was then tasked with finding and retrieving Ship before eliminating Skywalker.<ref name="Omen" />

The strike team tracked Ship to a [[Abeloth's planet|planet]] in [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]], where they met a powerful being named [[Abeloth]]. They eventually recovered Ship, although many members of the team were killed by the planet's deadly [[Plant/Legends|plants]] and Abeloth managed to keep them there long enough to eliminate their supplies and damage all of the [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]] aboard the ''Eternal Crusader'', as well as ground the ''Eternal Crusader'' itself. The Sith then traveled aboard Ship to [[Sinkhole Station]], a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in the Maw where Abeloth had located Skywalker and his son, [[Ben Skywalker|Ben]]. They ambushed the Jedi, but in the ensuing [[Skirmish at Sinkhole Station|skirmish]] the entire Sith team was eliminated except for Khai.<ref name="Abyss">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]''</ref> Khai fled in a dilapidated [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub]] [[StarTripper]] [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]], [[Bright Sun|''She's a Chancer'']], eventually landing on the planet [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] and sending out a [[Hypercomm/Legends|hypercomm]] message to the Sith on Kesh to retrieve her.<ref name="lash" />

===Alliance===
{{Quote|We have a common cause.''"<br />"''Are&mdash;are you suggesting we form an alliance?''"<br />"''Precisely.|High Lord Taalon and Grand Master Skywalker|<ref name="Allies" />}}
As the Sith organized a group of ships to travel to Dathomir to rescue Khai, Khai encountered the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]]&mdash;a group of [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]-using [[Witches of Dathomir|Witches]]&mdash;and decided that they could be of use to the Sith, reporting their existence to the Tribe. Lord [[Viun Gaalan]] led a group of shuttles to Dathomir, where they [[Skirmish in the Dathomir landing meadow|captured]] the Nightsisters. However, before Gaalan could retrieve Khai, the Skywalkers&mdash;who had tracked Khai to Dathomir&mdash;[[Duel in the Dathomir landing meadow|intervened]] along with the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Dyon Stadd]], and Gaalan was forced to flee without Khai. Taking Khai captive, the Jedi left Dathomir, but as they entered [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] they were ambushed by a group of eleven capital class ChaseMaster frigates<ref name="lash" /> under the command of High Lord Sarasu Taalon. Taalon lied to them that members of the Sith Tribe had been suffering from the same [[Force psychosis|psychosis]] as several Jedi back on the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] recently, and that he wished to form an alliance with the Jedi in order to eliminate Abeloth, who was causing the psychosis. In reality, the proposed alliance was simply a ploy by the Sith; their actual intention was to force Abeloth to cooperate with them.<ref name="Allies" />

Skywalker agreed to the alliance, and suggested that they contact his friend, [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], to assist them in navigating the Maw with his [[Colossus I Beta Series asteroid tug]], the ''[[Rockhound]]''. The Sith agreed, and the fleet of ships waited in orbit over [[Klatooine/Legends|Klatooine]], and while there, Taalon transferred command of the frigate ''Winged Dagger'' from Captain Syndor to his personal assistant, Leeha Faal. Eventually, however, the Sith and Jedi decided they could wait no longer, and left the planet, to wait for Calrissian just outside the Maw. Taalon convinced Skywalker to allow him to leave two frigates behind&mdash;the ''Starstalker'', captained by Vyn Holpur, and the ''Winged Dagger''&mdash;under the premise that they would await Calrissian's arrival. In reality, however, Taalon had given orders to Faal which she passed on to Holpur, commanding him to retrieve samples of [[wintrium]] from the sacred [[Fountain of Ancients|Fountain of the Ancients]] on Klatooine.<ref name="Allies" />

====Mission to the Maw====
{{Quote|Together, in an alliance not seen since this galaxy was new, Sith and Jedi will confront and defeat their mutual foe&mdash;one way or the other, And after that&hellip;well, let us see where we stand then, shall we?|Sarasu Taalon|<ref name="Allies" />}}
[[File:JustLando-AlliesBackCover.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Lando Calrissian's asteroid tug assisted the Sith armada in navigating the Maw.]]
The Sith were [[Violation|met with resistance]] from native [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinians]], and soon several [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] as well, who attacked the ''Starstalkker'' and surrounded the ''Winged Dagger'', taking the Sith into custody. They were brought to trial in front of Calrissian and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]], who had just arrived on the planet. Faal claimed that Holpur and his crew had acted of their own accord, and so the entire crew of the ''Starstalker'' was condemned to death. Faal, Calrissian, and Solo then left to meet the rest of the fleet outside of the Maw.<ref name="Allies" />

The fleet then entered the Maw under the protection of Calrissian's asteroid tug. However, upon their arrival at their first destination, Sinkhole Station, they found that the station had been destroyed by Abeloth. Two frigates, however, failed to slow down, entering the debris field at a great speed. The ''Rockhound'' used its [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beams]] to slow them, and managed to stop and save one of the ships. The other, however, was traveling at too great a velocity, and was obliterated upon impact. The Jedi and Sith then agreed to travel to Abeloth's planet, where they noticed Ship, still under Abeloth's control, and also saw the remains of the ''Eternal Crusader''. Once they had landed, the allies decided to search for Abeloth by [[Mind Walkers|Mind Walking]] [[beyond shadows]]. While beyond shadows, however, Faal was killed, and commission of the ''Winged Dagger'' was returned to Syndor.<ref name="Allies" />

The Sith and Jedi eventually located Abeloth and [[Mission to the Maw|fought]] her, and the Sith executed their betrayal by attempting to capture the dark side being. Meanwhile, Solo engaged Ship, who was still under Abeloth's influence, in combat in her [[StealthX]]. The Sith failed in their endeavor, however, and Skywalker defeated Abeloth; and immediately after Abeloth's<ref name="Allies" /> apparent<ref name="Vortex" /> death, Ship fled the system. The Sith and Jedi then agreed to send all of their respective forces away except for Taalon, Khai, Khai's father, [[Gavar Khai|Gavar]], the Skywalkers, and Stadd, who remained behind to investigate more about Abeloth.<ref name="Allies" />

===War===
{{Quote|There are Sith ''everywhere''. And they're building a war fleet!|Corran Horn|<ref name="Vortex" />}}
Solo and Calrissian left, but when they exited hyperspace they found they had arrived at the incorrect location. After discovering that someone had slipped a sabotage [[MSE-6 series repair droid/Legends|mouse droid]] aboard the ''Rockhound'' at Klatooine, they began to suspect pirates. Solo went out in her StealthX to [[Skirmish near Ashteri's Cloud|confront]] them, and found that they could feel her presence in the Force, and were thus Sith. She and Calrissian escaped and made it back to Coruscant, where they reported to the [[Jedi High Council (New Jedi Order)|Jedi Council]]. Meanwhile, they detailed a map with the assistance of Jedi Knight [[Jaden Korr]], showing that the Lost Tribe of Sith had been attacking vessels and taking them for use in their armada all over the galaxy. After further examination, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] realized that the Sith were preparing a war fleet.<ref name="Vortex" />

[[File:Luke-Allies.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Grand Master Luke Skywalker, temporary ally of the Sith]]
Meanwhile, after a [[Duel at the Pool of Knowledge|falling out]] between the Skywalkers and the three remaining Sith, the Jedi&mdash;with Vestara Khai in tow&mdash;tracked Abeloth to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Pydyr]]. There, however, Khai relayed a message to an outpost of the fleet on [[Boonta/Legends|Boonta]], where the message was passed on to Kesh. In response, a [[Kondo-class assault shuttle|''Kondo''-class assault shuttle]] was sent with Taalon and Gavar Khai. The Sith lost the shuttle, the ''[[Obuuri]]'', during the search for Abeloth, but were soon joined by three more ''Kondo''-class shuttles led by Sith Master [[Jestat Vhool]]. When they found Abeloth, however, she drove the members of the Sith fleet mad with visions. In the ensuing [[Battle in the Fallanassi village|battle]] with Abeloth, Taalon&mdash;who had begun to change into another being like Abeloth&mdash;was killed by Vestara Khai, and Abeloth was forced to flee. As the Jedi made to leave with Vestara, they were stopped by Vhool. Before the Sith could harm them, however, a wing of StealthXs sent from Coruscant arrived and engaged the Sith, allowing Vestara and the Jedi to escape.<ref name="Vortex" />

In the meantime, Gavar Khai developed a plan to find and eliminate a [[Jedi Queen project|Jedi queen]] of whom Taalon had had a vision. The Sith discovered that [[Hapan]] [[Queen Mother]] [[Tenel Ka Djo]] closely resembled the Jedi queen, and a team of Sith under Saber [[Querdan Dei]] aboard the EE-104 Fisheye ''[[Cryptic Warning]]'' was sent to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] her; but the plan was ultimately foiled. Gavar Khai meanwhile received a message from his daughter, informing him that she and the Jedi had tracked Abeloth to the planet [[Nam Chorios/Legends|Nam Chorios]]. Saber Khai was put in command of a flotilla led by several [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] frigates to execute [[Operation Shieldfall]]&mdash;a mission to kill the Skywalkers and eliminate or capture Abeloth. He sent Sith agents ahead of the fleet to take control of the world's orbiting [[Golan III Space Defense NovaGun]] [[Golan space defense platform|platforms]], but when the Sith arrived in-system, they were ambushed by a fleet of Jedi StealthXs. Before long, two of the frigates had been destroyed, with an additional two severely damaged. As the flotilla suffered heavy losses, Gavar was forced to order a full retreat. While the Sith recovered from the failed mission, Abeloth contacted Gavar and began to negotiate on the point of their mutual enemy&mdash;the Jedi.<ref name="Conviction" /> Abeloth was brought to Tahv, where the alliance was accepted. However, she betrayed the Sith, [[Destruction of Tahv|attacking]] Vol and the city. As she fled, a [[Abeloth's fleet|portion]] of the Sith armada, led by Gavar Khai in the ChaseMaster ''Black Wave'', defected to join Abeloth. They fired on the ships that remained loyal to the Lost Tribe and escaped with the dark side entity.<ref name="Ascension" />

While many Sith in the Tribe infiltrated Coruscant, which the New Jedi Order had vacated, a Sith wing of Skipray twelve-jays was sent to ambush the [[Jedi Academy (Ossus)|Jedi Academy]] on the planet [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]]. The local Jedi and Hapan forces were aware of the Sith plan, and the [[Hapes Consortium/Legends|Hapes Consortium]] sent four wings of [[Miy'til starfighter]]s to hold off the Sith while the [[Jedi academy|academy]] was [[Evacuation of Ossus (Lost Tribe of Sith emergence)|evacuated]]. The Sith still hoped to kill Djo, who was present for the evacuation; and they managed to board one of the Jedi's vessels and place [[Baradium/Legends|baradium]] bombs inside. The Jedi and Hapans noticed that the vessel, [[Sharmok 718]], was acting strangely, and came to believe the Sith had boarded. As such, the Hapans ordered their escorting [[Volgh Squadron]] to open fire; doing so resulted in setting off the baradium, destroying the entire vessel, the Jedi on board, and Volgh [[Squadron/Legends|Squadron]] itself, but Djo was saved from the attack. Soon afterward, the Tribe was severely crippled when the Jedi succeeded in their mission to [[Liberation of Coruscant (Lost Tribe of Sith emergence)|liberate]] Coruscant, eliminating the Sith forces on the world. Abeloth was also destroyed; nevertheless, Ship decided to ferry Vestara Khai to another Sith faction, the [[One Sith]], rather than back to the Tribe on Kesh.<ref name="Apocalypse" />

==Commanders and crew==
[[File:GavarKhai-Allies.jpg|thumb|left|141px|Lost Tribe member Gavar Khai]]
{{Quote|I am High Lord Sarasu Taalon, commander of this force.|High Lord Taalon, greeting Grand Master Skywalker|<ref name="Allies" />}}
At first, Ship served as the leader of the armada, as the Tribe relied on the Sith Meditation Sphere as their only means of space travel, as well as a source of knowing when and where to hit their next target. As the armada expanded, however, the Sith began to take over leadership, and vessels were placed under the command of high-ranking Tribe members, such as High Lords. One of the first vessels to be commandeered, the ''Eternal Crusader'', was put under the command of Lady Rhea. Also serving on that starship was Rhea's apprentice, Vestara Khai.<ref name="Omen" />

Lord Viun Gaalan later commanded a small group of shuttles to retrieve Khai from Dathomir,<ref name="lash" /> and eleven capital-class ChaseMaster frigates, including the ''Black Wave'', were placed under the command of High Lord Taalon. Also among these frigates were the ''Starstalker'', commanded by the Human Sith Vyn Holpur, and the ''Winged Dagger'', commanded first by Syndor, later by the Keshiri Leeha Faal, and then by Syndor again following Faal's death while beyond shadows.<ref name="Allies" /> Master Vhool commanded a trio of ''Kondo''-class shuttles.<ref name="Vortex" />

During Operation Shieldfall, Gavar Khai led a flotilla of Corporate Sector frigates.<ref name="Conviction" /> After Abeloth turned against the Lost Tribe in Tahv, however, a number of Sith in the armada defected to join her, including Khai and fellow Saber [[Tola Annax]].<ref name="Ascension" />

==Behind the scenes==
The armada first appeared in author [[Christie Golden]]'s [[2009]] debut ''[[Star Wars]]'' novel, ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Omen]]'', the second novel in the [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series. The armada went on to appear in each of the following ''Fate of the Jedi'' novels&mdash;''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]'', ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Backlash]]'', ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Allies]]'', ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Vortex]]'', ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Conviction]]'', ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Ascension]]'', and ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse]]''. The first mission undertaken by Ship and the Sith was depicted in a short story by Golden, "[[First Blood (short story)|First Blood]]," published in [[2011]]. The fleet was later mentioned in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''.

At the end of ''Apocalypse'', the Sith forces on Coruscant are eliminated. However, it was unspecified in both ''Ascension'' and ''Apocalypse'' exactly how many Sith of the Tribe stayed behind on their homeworld; nor was it specified whether or not the Tribe still possessed any ships capable of space flight.
